local_backend: SQLite FTS5 unicode61 plus existing deterministic dense hash ranking
cloud_backend: PostgreSQL built-in to_tsvector/websearch_to_tsquery with simple configuration plus same dense rank
semantic_preservation: user and paper scope filters are applied before/within lexical retrieval
hybrid ranking remains the existing rank_hybrid contract
numeric lexical scores are not required to be equal across engines
deterministic tie ordering remains chunk id ascending

chinese_evidence.finding: SQLite unicode61 is not a Chinese word segmenter; PostgreSQL simple configuration also does not provide meaningful Chinese tokenization
chinese_evidence.claim_boundary: Chinese semantic parity is not claimed; meaningful Chinese search requires a separately approved tokenizer/backend

sqlite_fts_sql_guard: FTS5 insert/search/delete branches execute only when SQLAlchemy dialect is sqlite
